propositions: Bare `except Exception` in `_assemble_context_uncached` silently swallows `list_tickets` and per-child `show_ticket` failures, leaving `children` empty without recording incompleteness.
An empty `children` list flips `PlanContext.has_children` to `False`, causing container-scoped DET checks (`p5_task_dag`, `p8_reviewability`) to return trivial pass instead of incompleteness signals.

Hierarchy enumeration or per-child fetch failures should be recorded via `hierarchy_incomplete` flag and `hierarchy_incomplete_detail` list, then threaded through all five `finalize_verdict` call sites via the `coverage` dict.
`finalize_verdict` and `drift_floor._recompute_verdict_after_drop` must convert `hierarchy_incomplete=True` to `INDETERMINATE` verdict, preventing clean PASS when context assembly failed.
All four `plan_review_coach` steps in the workflow YAML must explicitly pass `hierarchy_incomplete` and `hierarchy_incomplete_detail` via `with:` block to support coach-path verdict routing.
Bounded retry (2 attempts, 50ms delay) on `list_tickets` and per-child `show_ticket` calls must exhaust before recording incompleteness, catching the same broad `Exception` caught today.
